title: Catalana Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful Chinese-inspired stir fry made with catalana peppers and chicken, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced catalana peppers and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken to the wok or skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and crema.
Pour the soy sauce and crema mixture over the chicken and vegetables, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
